title: FTW Global — Field & Boundary Probabilities 2017 (COG)
description:
Field and boundary probability rasters for 2017: 7,466 Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs at 2.5 m (2.95 TB), one per Sentinel-2 MGRS-based tile at `raster/2017/{tile_key}.tif`. Explore the year on the [interactive map](https://research.taylorgeospatial.org/global-ftw-2e/web/#year=2017), walk its metadata in the [Portolan browser](https://browser.portolan-sdi.org/#/external/data.source.coop/ftw/global-data-2e/raster/2017/collection.json), or download the files from [Source Cooperative](https://source.coop/ftw/global-data-2e). Part of [Fields of the World](https://fieldsofthe.world) — agricultural field boundaries delineated from Sentinel-2 imagery.

**The rasters.** Each COG is 40,032 × 40,032 pixels at 2.5 m in its tile's UTM zone, with two uint8 bands scaled by 1/255: `field` (band 1, field-interior probability) and `boundary` (band 2, field-boundary probability). ZSTD-compressed COG layout with average-resampled overviews down to 626 px. Produced by the `unet_balanced_fp32` FTW model from 16 input bands (B02/B03/B04/B08 × quarters Q1–Q4 of the year's [Sentinel-2 quarterly cloudless mosaics](https://source.coop/tge-labs/sentinel-2-quarterly-cloudless-mosaics/), 10 m); each COG's GDAL metadata records its four source mosaic tiles (`source_items`).

Per-item STAC metadata is generated to the bucket next to each COG; the [index manifest](https://data.source.coop/ftw/global-data-2e/index/raster.parquet) lists every tile with href, size, bbox, and per-tile field/boundary/cropland pixel fractions. The pipeline that produced these COGs is documented in [pipeline/README.md](https://github.com/fieldsoftheworld/ftw-global-data-catalog/blob/main/pipeline/README.md).
